workExperience.description:
Developing a prototype with dual interfaces: one for hospitals and one for users.
Hospitals can update real-time data such as bed availability, on-duty doctors, and other critical information
every 20–30 minutes.
Users can search for available hospital beds in real time to facilitate faster emergency response.

Developed a quiz-based app featuring multiple-choice questions.
Displays a final score summary upon quiz completion.
Designed a clean and responsive UI to enhance user interaction and input experience.

Built a web-based application that suggests songs based on the user’s selected mood.
Utilized JavaScript to map moods to a curated song library, selecting tracks randomly per category.
Includes additional options for random song or playlist recommendations.
